# AngleFinder

AngleFinder is a free online precision tool for measuring angles. It includes a 360° protractor, triangle calculator, and image angle measurement. No signup required.

## Core Pages

- Home: https://anglefinder.co/ — Free online angle finder with protractor, triangle calculator, and image measurement
- Protractor: https://anglefinder.co/protractor — 360° online protractor, drag to rotate, copy results
- Triangle Calculator: https://anglefinder.co/calculator — Solve triangles with SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, HL
- Image Measure: https://anglefinder.co/image — Upload photos and measure angles by clicking points
- Privacy Policy: https://anglefinder.co/privacy-policy
- Terms of Service: https://anglefinder.co/terms-of-service

## Key Facts

- All tools are free, no signup required
- Results are for educational use
- Images processed locally in browser, not uploaded to servers
- Supports degrees, radians, and gradians

## Contact

- Website: https://anglefinder.co
- Email: support@anglefinder.co
